content.short: Star Atlas DAO is a decentralized autonomous organization governing the AAA blockchain game, Star Atlas.
content.description: Star Atlas DAO enables a community-driven governance model for the Star Atlas ecosystem, inviting members to vote on development proposals and help shape the project's future. Each participant's voting power is tied to their POLIS holdings and their demonstrated commitment to the Star Atlas ecosystem. To participate in on-chain governance, POLIS must be staked. The DAO currently counts over 40,000 members actively contributing to governance discussions and voting on proposals.
